captions.detailed: An orchestra-style music stand finished in matte black. It features a broad, tilted sheet-music desk with a lower retaining lip, supported by a telescoping vertical center pole. The bottom is anchored by a stable, three-legged tripod base. The telescoping pole allows for vertical height adjustment, while the desk joint permits tilt angle adjustment.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an orchestra music stand with a matte black finish. It must feature a tripod base with three thin legs, a vertical telescoping central shaft with a tightening collar, and a wide rectangular sheet-music desk with a bottom lip, attached with a rear bracket.
captions.factory: The code constructs the music stand in several parts. The tripod base is built using thin cylinders rotated 120 degrees apart around a central hub cylinder. The telescoping shaft consists of two nested vertical cylinders (lower and upper) with a small cylindrical collar and tightening knob. The sheet-music desk is modeled using a thin box for the main board, combined with a smaller rectangular lip box at the bottom and a rectangular bracket on the rear. Finally, these parts are assembled with rigid or relative offsets.
